description: Returns what goes into one dish of Dusty's menu and how far that can be relied on: whether the restaurant has verified the list, has changed it since, has entered it without verifying it, or has entered nothing. For each ingredient it gives a description in the restaurant's words, what a composite ingredient is made of, and the allergens it contains or may contain, of the fourteen the law names; then the allergens of the whole dish; and, for a verified dish the restaurant has the figures for, what one of it adds up to in energy, fat, carbohydrate, protein and salt. How much of each ingredient goes in is not given.

name.description: The dish's name on Dusty's menu, e.g. Margherita.
